snippet.title: Starsand Island - Launch Window Trailer | Xbox @ gamescom 2025
snippet.description:
Join friends or build a new life by yourself on Starsand Island. Fish, build, and get to your your fellow villagers when Starsand Island comes to Xbox in Spring 2026. 

This video was originally produced by Xbox @ gamescom 2025: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lu6R8W91lM8

#IGN #Xbox #gamescom2025
